name: Siscon! -Sister Compact-
source:
She's got big love in a small body! Summer vacation is a taboo affair between imouto the oniichan she loves.

For some reason "your" parents decided to go on holiday right when you came home to visit them for the summer. Cute little Hiyori and you are aaaaaaall alone in the house for two solid months!

Nobody can look at her adorable features and not get excited. Siblings start with indoor fun... then take it outside!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ160012.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
她小小的身体里蕴含着大爱！暑假对于她所爱的哥哥来说是一件禁忌的事情。

由于某种原因，“你的”父母决定在你暑假回家探望他们时就去度假。可爱的小日和和你独自在家里呆了整整两个月！

没有人看到她可爱的容貌会不兴奋。兄弟姐妹从室内玩乐开始……然后带到户外！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ160012.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
